CLGSQLAP14.code:
and the order date for customers who ordered that particular product.

    the total amount spent by each customer across all their orders. In descending order
    .
SELECT 
    p.product_name,
    c.category_name,
    cu.customer_name,
    o.order_date
FROM orders o
JOIN customers cu
    ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id
JOIN products p
    ON o.product_name = p.product_name
JOIN categories c
    ON p.category_id = c.category_id;
    SELECT 
    cu.customer_name,
    SUM(p.price * o.quantity) AS total_spent
FROM customers cu
JOIN orders o
    ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p
    ON o.product_name = p.product_name
GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.customer_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

CLGSQLAP119.code:
CREATE TABLE Doctors (
    DoctorID INT PRIMARY KEY,
    Name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    Specialization VARCHAR(100),
    ContactNumber VARCHAR(15),
    Email VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE Patients (
    PatientID INT PRIMARY KEY,
    Name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    DOB DATE,
    Gender TEXT CHECK (Gender IN ('Male', 'Female', 'Other')),
    ContactNumber VARCHAR(15),
    Address TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE Appointments (
    AppointmentID INT PRIMARY KEY,
    PatientID INT,
    DoctorID INT,
    AppointmentDate DATE,
    Status TEXT CHECK (Status IN ('Scheduled', 'Completed', 'Cancelled')),
    FOREIGN KEY (PatientID) REFERENCES Patients(PatientID) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (DoctorID) REFERENCES Doctors(DoctorID) ON DELETE SET NULL
);
CREATE TABLE Treatments (
    TreatmentID INT PRIMARY KEY,
    PatientID INT,
    DoctorID INT,
    Diagnosis VARCHAR(255),
    TreatmentDescription TEXT,
    TreatmentDate DATE,
    FOREIGN KEY (PatientID) REFERENCES Patients(PatientID) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (DoctorID) REFERENCES Doctors(DoctorID) ON DELETE SET NULL
);
CREATE TABLE MedicalRecords (
    RecordID INT PRIMARY KEY,
    PatientID INT,
    TreatmentID INT,
    Notes TEXT,
    RecordDate DATE,
    FOREIGN KEY (PatientID) REFERENCES Patients(PatientID) ON DELETE CASCADE,

WITH DoctorTreatments AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN d.Specialization = 'Cardiology'
                THEN 'Cardiology Department'
            WHEN d.Specialization = 'Neurology'
                THEN 'Neurology Department'
        END AS Department,
        d.Name AS Doctor,
        COUNT(t.TreatmentID) AS TotalTreatments
    FROM Doctors d
    JOIN Treatments t
        ON d.DoctorID = t.DoctorID
    GROUP BY d.DoctorID, d.Name, d.Specialization
)
SELECT
    Department,
    Doctor,
    TotalTreatments,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY Department
        ORDER BY TotalTreatments DESC
    ) AS RankWithinDepartment
FROM DoctorTreatments
ORDER BY Department;

SELECT
    o.OrderID,
    o.CustomerID,
    o.OrderDate,
    SUM(od.Quantity * od.UnitPrice) AS TotalOrderAmount
FROM Orders o
JOIN OrderDetails od
    ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID
GROUP BY o.OrderID, o.CustomerID, o.OrderDate
HAVING SUM(od.Quantity * od.UnitPrice) >= ALL (
    SELECT SUM(od2.Quantity * od2.UnitPrice)
    FROM Orders o2
    JOIN OrderDetails od2
        ON o2.OrderID = od2.OrderID
    WHERE o2.CustomerID = o.CustomerID
    GROUP BY o2.OrderID
)
ORDER BY o.CustomerID;

SELECT
    n.connection_id,
    n.origin,
    n.destination,
    CASE
        WHEN n.distance * t.cost_per_distance >= 1500 THEN 'High cost'
        WHEN n.distance * t.cost_per_distance >= 1000
             AND n.distance * t.cost_per_distance < 1500 THEN 'Medium cost'
        ELSE 'Low cost'
    END AS cost_category

JOIN Truck t
    ON n.truck_id = t.truck_id

ORDER BY n.connection_id;

    r.destination,

JOIN Network n
    ON r.origin = n.origin
   AND r.destination = n.destination
JOIN Truck t
    ON n.truck_id = t.truck_id
WHERE n.truck_id = 'Truck2'
ORDER BY profit DESC;
